versions.subject: rule: improved Empire detection
versions.detection:
selection:
    c-useragent: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko'
    cs-uri-query:
        - '/admin/get.php'
        - '/news.php'
        - '/login/process.php'
    cs-method: 'POST'
condition: selection
versions.spl: "c-useragent"="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" "cs-uri-query" IN ("/admin/get.php", "/news.php", "/login/process.php") "cs-method"="POST"
